u1: The matching key has been located, but the agent does not yet carry it. Navigate to the key and pick it up; the next milestone is has_matching_key. If the key is visible but out of reach, move toward its cell.
u2: The matching-key milestone has been reached, but the target door has not yet been opened. If the key is still in hand, go to the locked door and toggle it open; if the key has been dropped, recover it first. The next objective is target_door_open.
u3: The target door has been opened at least once, but the agent has not yet entered the target room. Move through the doorway into the room; if the door has been closed again, reopen it with the matching key. The next objective is target_room_entered, and the key must be dropped before the ball can be carried.
u4: The agent has entered the target room but has not yet picked up the mission ball. Move to the ball and pick it up with empty hands; if still carrying the key, drop it first. The next objective is target_picked_up, which completes the mission.
u5: Terminal success: the agent has picked up the mission ball and the episode ends. No further subtask is needed; remain in this absorbing completed state.
